Tela Marine Research Center limits dive groups to 30 to 40 divers per day. AMATELA Marine Wildlife Refuge (86,259 ha, declared 2018) and Jeannette Kawas National Park (Punta Sal, 1994) provide formal protection with active enforcement. Wakatobi National Park covers 1.39 million hectares but strict no-take zones represent only 3.2% of total area. Wakatobi Dive Resort operates the Wakatobi Collaborative Reef Conservation Program — one of the world's largest privately-funded MPAs — with lease agreements covering all 17 villages in exchange for fishing restrictions. All resort guests sign a dive conduct agreement. Operation Wallacea runs annual scientific expeditions from Hoga Island Research Centre. Enforcement patrols dropped significantly after TNC and WWF scaled back in 2014-2015; community monitoring groups including Komunto (UN Equator Award 2010) continue voluntary protection. Choose operators aligned with the Wakatobi Resort conservation program or Operation Wallacea.

Panaon Island Protected Seascape (61,204 ha) was declared under Philippine law in August 2025, encompassing the outer bay reefs. Southern Leyte has 82 community-managed MPAs covering approximately 1,400 hectares. Whale shark encounters are snorkel-only by local ordinance since 2008 — scuba diving with whale sharks is prohibited. Maximum 3-hour snorkel session per tour group; 3-meter minimum approach distance enforced. LAMAVE (Large Marine Vertebrates Research Institute) monitors the whale shark aggregation year-round and welcomes observer reports. Kasaka Fishermen's Association manages ecotourism at Son-ok MPA in Pintuyan. Inner bay fishing pressure remains high with documented illegal use of compressor rigs, cyanide, and vessels from neighbouring provinces.

Berau MPA (285,549 ha, declared 2016) covers the archipelago with red no-take zones at Samama Island and green limited-use zones at Derawan and Sangalaki. Global Conservation deployed SMART patrol teams and 24/7 Marine Monitor radar across five islands in 2023-2024; 8 vessel seizures and a 2-year prison sentence for fish bombing followed in 2024. No formal visitor quota exists. Marine Megafauna Foundation researchers are based at Sangalaki and run manta ray photo-ID monitoring year-round — report encounters to contribute to the dataset. Turtle Foundation protects nesting beaches. Choose operators partnered with MMF or Global Conservation. Proximity to Indonesia's new capital Nusantara (160 km) is accelerating regional development pressure.

mpaName: Area Marina Protetta di Torre Guaceto
visitorImpactNote: Torre Guaceto is a Mediterranean conservation success. A small fully protected core, co managed with the local fishers who once emptied it, brought the fish back. Across 12 years of surveys from 2004 to 2015, white sea bream, a prime local catch, were found roughly 3 to 7 times denser inside the fully protected zone than on the coast just outside. Divers visit through the reserve, and the main things to tread lightly around are the Posidonia seagrass meadows and the shallow reef.
manualReefStateBasis: Strongly protected and recovering. Across 12 years of surveys from 2004 to 2015, white sea bream, a prime fished species, were measured roughly **3 to 7 times denser** inside the fully protected zone than on the adjacent unprotected coast. Well enforced Mediterranean reserves like this one, closed to fishing, carry total fish biomass **around 8 times** that of fished coast, and Torre Guaceto holds a Blue Park Award for effective protection.

visitorImpactNote: Abrolhos Marine National Park protects the richest coral reefs in the South Atlantic, and its fully protected reefs carry far more fish than the fished banks around them. Divers visit through the park, and the main pressures on this reef come from mainland runoff and fishing on the wider Abrolhos Bank rather than from inside the park itself.
manualReefStateBasis: Improving under protection: reef fish biomass on the fully protected reefs of this national marine park reached about 148 grams per square metre, roughly eighteen times the 8 grams per square metre on the most heavily fished reefs nearby (Bruce et al. 2012).

topPressures: fishing pressure on the surrounding reefs

manualReefStateBasis: Improving under protection: after more than a decade closed to fishing, reef fish biomass inside this sanctuary reached about 886 kilograms per hectare, against roughly 285 kilograms per hectare on the fished reefs nearby (McClanahan et al. 2009).
